blocks.text: Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic is a mental health and addiction treatment facility that has been operating for 15 years, specializing in services for women with mental health, addiction, and trauma issues. They believe that the way each gender deals with such issues is dramatically different and, therefore, the treatments and therapies need to be as well. Their non-12-Step, evidence-based approach is aimed at providing specialized care to women with such needs.

sections.heading: Georgia Strait Womens Clinic- Center Overview

blocks.text: The Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic is a specialized treatment facility that offers comprehensive services to women who are struggling with their mental health. Since 1991, the clinic has been providing licensed and accredited mental health programs, including 24-hour medical care, psychiatry, psychology, nutrition, and fitness support. Additionally, the clinic provides specialized bodywork and other essential services, bringing together the expertise of highly-trained, experienced professionals who are committed to high-quality care.
blocks.html: The Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic is a specialized treatment facility that offers comprehensive services to women who are struggling with their mental health. Since 1991, the clinic has been providing licensed and accredited mental health programs, including 24-hour medical care, psychiatry, psychology, nutrition, and fitness support. Additionally, the clinic provides specialized bodywork and other essential services, bringing together the expertise of highly-trained, experienced professionals who are committed to high-quality care.

blocks.text: The clinic has helped numerous women overcome their mental health challenges and has treated over 4,492 patients. The senior staff and health professionals boast a collective 121 years of addiction and mental health care experience. The clinic’s focus is on high-functioning and motivated women, and it does not provide 12-step treatments for addiction. As the only women’s-only facility of its kind in Canada, Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic is committed to providing specialized care to women who want to improve their mental health and well-being.

centre.about_html:
Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic is a mental health and addiction treatment facility that has been operating for 15 years, specializing in services for women with mental health, addiction, and trauma issues. They believe that the way each gender deals with such issues is dramatically different and, therefore, the treatments and therapies need to be as well. Their non-12-Step, evidence-based approach is aimed at providing specialized care to women with such needs.

Expert and Empathetic Professionals at Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic

Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic emphasizes the importance of having a highly skilled, compassionate, and curious team of professionals to help each client, be it a woman, non-binary, or transgendered individual. Many of their staff members have walked through addiction themselves, which gives them unmatched empathy and expert clinical knowledge. They offer the privacy and attention of a smaller facility while operating as a large facility.

Specialized Programming for Each Woman at Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic

Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic specializes in helping women who have experienced trauma. They create an atmosphere of support and safety where women can work through past traumas and gain the tools they need to thrive. The use of cell phones and laptops allows women to stay connected with employers, employees, and family during their treatment. Their on-staff nursing and clinical detoxification ensure the safety and comfort of women at all stages of their treatment.

Private, Restorative Accommodations at Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic

At Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic, women have their own apartment-style suites with a small kitchen, seating area, private bathroom, bedroom, and wireless internet. They enjoy access to the facility’s gym, yoga studio, group dining room and TV room, laundry facilities, and the quiet nature surrounding the centre. These private accommodations allow women to feel comfortable and safe during their treatment.



Georgia Strait Womens Clinic- Center Overview

The Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic is a specialized treatment facility that offers comprehensive services to women who are struggling with their mental health. Since 1991, the clinic has been providing licensed and accredited mental health programs, including 24-hour medical care, psychiatry, psychology, nutrition, and fitness support. Additionally, the clinic provides specialized bodywork and other essential services, bringing together the expertise of highly-trained, experienced professionals who are committed to high-quality care.

The clinic has helped numerous women overcome their mental health challenges and has treated over 4,492 patients. The senior staff and health professionals boast a collective 121 years of addiction and mental health care experience. The clinic’s focus is on high-functioning and motivated women, and it does not provide 12-step treatments for addiction. As the only women’s-only facility of its kind in Canada, Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic is committed to providing specialized care to women who want to improve their mental health and well-being.

raw_html:
Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic is a mental health and addiction treatment facility that has been operating for 15 years, specializing in services for women with mental health, addiction, and trauma issues. They believe that the way each gender deals with such issues is dramatically different and, therefore, the treatments and therapies need to be as well. Their non-12-Step, evidence-based approach is aimed at providing specialized care to women with such needs.

Expert and Empathetic Professionals at Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic

Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic emphasizes the importance of having a highly skilled, compassionate, and curious team of professionals to help each client, be it a woman, non-binary, or transgendered individual. Many of their staff members have walked through addiction themselves, which gives them unmatched empathy and expert clinical knowledge. They offer the privacy and attention of a smaller facility while operating as a large facility.

Specialized Programming for Each Woman at Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic

Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic specializes in helping women who have experienced trauma. They create an atmosphere of support and safety where women can work through past traumas and gain the tools they need to thrive. The use of cell phones and laptops allows women to stay connected with employers, employees, and family during their treatment. Their on-staff nursing and clinical detoxification ensure the safety and comfort of women at all stages of their treatment.

Private, Restorative Accommodations at Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic

At Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic, women have their own apartment-style suites with a small kitchen, seating area, private bathroom, bedroom, and wireless internet. They enjoy access to the facility’s gym, yoga studio, group dining room and TV room, laundry facilities, and the quiet nature surrounding the centre. These private accommodations allow women to feel comfortable and safe during their treatment.



Georgia Strait Womens Clinic- Center Overview

The Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic is a specialized treatment facility that offers comprehensive services to women who are struggling with their mental health. Since 1991, the clinic has been providing licensed and accredited mental health programs, including 24-hour medical care, psychiatry, psychology, nutrition, and fitness support. Additionally, the clinic provides specialized bodywork and other essential services, bringing together the expertise of highly-trained, experienced professionals who are committed to high-quality care.

The clinic has helped numerous women overcome their mental health challenges and has treated over 4,492 patients. The senior staff and health professionals boast a collective 121 years of addiction and mental health care experience. The clinic’s focus is on high-functioning and motivated women, and it does not provide 12-step treatments for addiction. As the only women’s-only facility of its kind in Canada, Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic is committed to providing specialized care to women who want to improve their mental health and well-being.
